about.title: About Neobee Hospital PLC
about.lead: The full story of the project — why it exists, where it will stand, how it is governed, and who to reach.
about.purpose: Commercial, yet humane — কমার্শিয়াল কিন্তু মানবিক। To serve the country and its people with whatever means Allah has granted us.
about.location: Two sites have been shortlisted for the hospital — at Panchlaish and beside Chattogram Medical College. Site selection is near-final; the project will proceed at one of the two, In sha Allah.
about.governance: Discussions with doctors are ongoing on a 60:40 basis, with doctors being added through continuous exchange of views. The hospital will be governed by a combined board of doctors and civilian entrepreneurs. Qualified entrepreneurs will be given a place on the management committee, with a special salary structure for directors until inauguration.
about.model: The project will onboard 50 founding partners/entrepreneurs. Entry is ৳20,00,000 (self-invested or raised through shareholders), used for the registered bayna of the land. Entrepreneurs must be honest and responsible.
about.benefits: A planned monthly honorarium from construction through inauguration; eligibility for the management committee; and a ৳20,000 share incentive per share — ৳2,00,000 of bonus shares on a 10-share subscription.
about.deposit: A bank account in the name of NEOBEE is being opened. Deposits are made to the institution's account only. On deposit, every shareholder immediately receives a unique ID, a digital money receipt, and website access — digital services delivered in partnership with NeoTech.
